name: Gasthaus Tiroler Weinstube
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Tiroler Weinstube is centrally located in Seefeld in Tirol. The building harmoniously blends traditional Tyrolean architecture with modern amenities. Regional wines and local dishes are served in the inviting wine tavern. The surrounding area is defined by the scenic alpine scenery of the Seefeld plateau. Guest rooms are appointed with modern bathrooms and Tyrolean wooden furnishings. Guests enjoy access to a sauna area and relaxation rooms. The inn is situated within easy walking distance of both the train station and the village centre.
